name: Sidebar navigation
summary: The left rail of a work app: workspace switcher, search with a shortcut, grouped pages with counts, a collapsible group and the signed-in person.
use: as the main navigation of a work app
a11y: A nav landmark with labelled lists; the current page carries aria-current="page", the collapsible group is a native details/summary, and the switcher and person menus are buttons with aria-haspopup.

use_when: a desktop work app with several sections and more than one workspace or team
avoid_when: fewer than five pages, or a consumer phone app: use a bottom tab bar or page-header-tabs
finding any page or action by typing: use command-menu, opened from this rail's search button
tabs inside one page: use page-header-tabs

parts.name: switcher
parts.what: workspace button: a letter mark, the workspace name and its plan or size

parts.name: search
parts.what: search button with its shortcut keys

parts.name: headings
parts.what: a section heading such as Payables

parts.name: items
parts.what: one page link: icon, label and an optional count; the current page is raised

parts.name: count
parts.what: a number beside a page; is-new makes it an accent pill

parts.name: person
parts.what: the signed-in person: photo with an online dot, name and role

empty.how: a rail always has pages; for a new workspace with no sections yet, show only Home and Inbox

loading.how: keep the switcher and show muted bars in place of the item labels and counts

error.how: if counts fail to load, hide the counts and leave the links working

disabled.how: for a page the person cannot open, drop the href, set aria-disabled and grey the item

overflow.how: the rail grows with its items; give the nav a scroll box with overflow-y: auto between the search button and the person

long_text.how: long page labels and the workspace detail are cut with an ellipsis; the workspace name wraps

keyboard: Tab moves through the workspace switcher, Search, each page link, the collapsible group heading and the person button
Enter or Space on the group heading opens or closes it, as a native details element
The switcher, Search and person buttons open nothing yet, and Cmd+K is labelled but not wired
